description.value: Congee Noodle Delight is a family-owned Hong Kong-style restaurant inside International Village Mall in downtown Vancouver, operating since 2015. It serves traditional congee, BBQ meats, wonton noodle soup, and sizeable sharing plates drawn from classic Hong Kong cuisine. Touring cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver will find both dine-in and takeout options at street level along West Pender Street.

address.value: 1021-88 West Pender St, Vancouver, BC V6B 6N9
